summary: Sourcey 3.6.5 generated an eight-entry llms.txt for runxhq/runx from pinned commit da74ceef021159fdb9d2d4929710bf85274d8db2; the artifact and its upstream PR are public and reproducible.
observations: The target is the maintained OSS repository https://github.com/runxhq/runx at pinned commit da74ceef021159fdb9d2d4929710bf85274d8db2.
Sourcey version 3.6.5 ran with: sourcey build --config sourcey.config.ts --output sourcey-docs.
The checked-in sourcey.config.ts identifies real README.md and docs/**/*.md inputs, proving llms.txt was generated from project source rather than hand-written.
Sourcey reported a successful build of 8 pages and emitted llms.txt plus matching HTML pages under sourcey-docs/documentation.
The generated llms.txt is publicly fetchable at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/6pt6brty57-star/runx/codex/sourcey-llms/sourcey-docs/llms.txt.
Upstream PR https://github.com/runxhq/runx/pull/284 is opened against runxhq/runx and contains the generated artifact, config, and maintainer-facing rationale.
The governed validation used runx receipt runx:receipt:sha256:c5ecd7100c021f7a877734c32a15ef28b0c01dd65f1772ed6855474df9c6ca8f; its public JSON is included with the artifact.
Eight llms.txt entries map to generated pages backed by README.md and seven real files in docs/.
Five audited entries are Getting Started, Agent Skills, Operator Skills, Issue To PR Flow, and Publishing; each has a corresponding generated HTML target and source Markdown file.
